name: World Government
overview: Scripture reveals a future world government characterized by a coalition of kings and kingdoms, as described in Daniel's visions of ten kings and a diverse ruler who subdues others (Daniel 7:24). This earthly dominion, symbolized by beasts with multiple heads and horns in Revelation, will exert power over all nations and oppose the saints (Revelation 13:1, 13:7). However, God’s eternal kingdom will ultimately replace and destroy these earthly powers, establishing an everlasting reign that will never be left to others (Daniel 2:44). Meanwhile, the gospel of this kingdom will be preached throughout the world as a witness before the end comes (Matthew 24:14), with the return of Christ anticipated as decisively as the days of Noah (Matthew 24:37).
